title: 100,000 orders from a paging API
prompt: src/api.ts can serve 100,000 orders: fetchOrders(start, end, sort) returns the orders from start to end (end exclusive), sorted by one column if asked, with the total count. In src/App.svelte, show all the orders in a grid with the columns Order #, Symbol, Qty and Price, sortable by any column, without loading all 100,000 into the browser.

idioms.name: backs the grid with a row source
